author: github_rest_publication
source_contract: Exact source hash and immutable target/base/count/identity root release before credentials/API.
Local raw commit SHA and UTF8 canonical tree/one-parent/author/committer headers with original offsets and message preserved; extra headers rejected before credentials/API.
Binary local Git cat-file object reads; immutable blob SHA/size gates; no lazy fetch/replacement objects.
Per-call direct HTTP/1.1, UseProxy=false, no redirects or TLS override, 45 seconds, no retries.
GCM fill only after local preflight; token in memory only; no raw output/response persisted.
Every returned blob SHA, complete tree SHA and created commit SHA must match the reviewed immutable local objects.
Ref PATCH only exact target, force=false, with identity/ref/localHEAD prechecks and independent successful-postchecks required.
Unique attempt receipt outside snapshot; no existing receipt overwrite or automatic replay.
No local stage/commit/fetch/push/repo creation/source snapshot mutation.
honest_limits: Source/AST readiness is not actual API success.
GitHub docs do not promise arbitrary raw commit byte preservation; unsupported headers rejected, any returned SHA normalization mismatch stops before ref PATCH.
GET-before-PATCH and force=false are not a compare-and-swap API; unexpected observed heads stop, concurrent divergent heads are rejected by fast-forward restriction.
Failed object creation may leave unreferenced objects; failed PATCH is unknown/unconfirmed and never claimed published.
